description.en-US:
BEUConnect is a student app for Bihar Engineering University (BEU). The syllabus, previous year papers, notes, notices and college rosters live on the device, so most of it works without a connection.

Features:
* Syllabus for BEU branches and semesters, with topics, GATE papers and a saved list.
* Previous year papers with PDFs and a paper finder.
* Results from BEU's result API, a saved copy, the published result tables, or BEU's own result page.
* University rank, merit list and a side-by-side result comparison.
* Attendance tracker, SGPA calculator and predictor, routine and holiday calendar.
* Notes, planner, notices and search across the bundled data.
* Published college and branch rosters and CGPA leaders.

Data and privacy: a registration number is stored on the device and sent only to BEU's result endpoints to resolve a name and result. No account is required, and there are no ads or analytics. Feedback is sent only when you submit it.

Source code: https://github.com/pritkr/beuConnect (AGPL-3.0-or-later).
